capabilities: Compile tikz code blocks with a local TeX distribution and dvisvgm
Show the real compiler log when a diagram fails to compile
Open rendered diagrams in a zoomable, pannable viewer
Cache compiled SVGs inside the plugin folder
Share rendered diagrams with mobile devices through a synced vault folder
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Compilation only works on desktop; mobile devices can only display diagrams shared from a desktop. Shell escape is off by default and flagged as dangerous, and the README documents SVG sanitisation and file-read caveats.
intentEvidence: A rewrite of artisticat1/obsidian-tikzjax, see License.
problem: Existing in-app TikZ rendering relies on limited browser WASM engines and hides real compiler errors when a diagram fails.

relations.evidence: A rewrite of artisticat1/obsidian-tikzjax, see License.

requires.name: TeX distribution with dvisvgm (TeX Live, MacTeX or MiKTeX)

summary: Renders TikZ code blocks by compiling them with a locally installed TeX distribution instead of a browser WASM engine.
